Faq.title: Questions before you book

items.question: What if something gets damaged or missing?
items.answer: We fully vet our local specialists and carry comprehensive insurance coverage.

items.question: Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?
items.answer: No, our professionals bring high-quality eco-friendly products and standard equipment.

items.question: How do I pay for the service?
items.answer: Pay securely after the job is completed and inspected — via Cash, Card, or Revolut.

items.question: Can I book a recurring plan?
items.answer: Yes, we offer regular subscription plans that save you up to 20% on home care.

Footer.cities: Faro, Loulé, Quarteira, Vilamoura, Almancil, Albufeira

cleaning.title: Cleaning
cleaning.subtitle: Explore each room — tap a marker to see exactly what we clean.

hob.title: Hob & stove
hob.text: We degrease the hob, burners and nearby splash zones until they look brand new.

counters.title: Worktops
counters.text: Counters are wiped, crumbs removed, and every surface left fresh and clear.

fronts.title: Cabinet fronts
fronts.text: Fronts and handles are cleaned of fingerprints, marks and light grease.

sink.title: Sink & faucet
sink.text: The sink and faucet are cleaned and polished, with available dishes washed and left tidy.

toilet.title: Toilet
toilet.text: The bowl and seat are disinfected carefully for a hygienic finish.

taps.title: Taps & chrome
taps.text: Mixers and chrome details are washed and polished to a soft shine.

glass.title: Shower glass
glass.text: Glass panels are cleaned streak-free so the shower feels bright again.

floor.title: Floor
floor.text: The bathroom floor is vacuumed and mopped with care.

under-bed.title: Under the bed
under-bed.text: Accessible areas under the bed are vacuumed and left dust-free.

bedding.title: Bedding
bedding.text: Bed linen is straightened or remade so the room feels calm and finished.

dusting.title: Dusting
dusting.text: Light objects are lifted so shelves and surfaces are dusted properly.

mirrors.title: Mirrors & glass
mirrors.text: Mirrors and glass are cleaned streak-free for a bright look.

surfaces.title: Surfaces
surfaces.text: Tables, shelves and décor surfaces are dusted and wiped gently.

floors.title: Floors
floors.text: Floors are vacuumed and washed, including easy-to-reach corners.

glass.title: Glass & frames
glass.text: Glass details and frames are cleaned for a clear, polished finish.

repair.title: Home Repairs
repair.subtitle: Tap the markers to see the careful, everyday fixes we handle at home.

assemble.title: Furniture assembly
assemble.text: Neat flat-pack assembly for shelves, desks and wardrobes.

shelves.title: Shelves & mounting
shelves.text: Shelves are mounted level and secured cleanly on the wall.

taps.title: Taps & mixers
taps.text: We replace or adjust taps and mixers for smooth everyday use.

minor-leak.title: Minor plumbing
minor-leak.text: Seals, connections and simple leak checks — tidy and careful.

sockets.title: Sockets & switches
sockets.text: Sockets and switches replaced for safer, cleaner daily use.

fixtures.title: Light fixtures
fixtures.text: Standard light fixtures hung and connected neatly.

hinges.title: Hinges & alignment
hinges.text: Doors are adjusted so they close smoothly and quietly again.

handles.title: Handles & locks
handles.text: Handle and lock fixes for everyday doors around the home.

MassageCatalog.title: Massage
MassageCatalog.tagline: Professional massage, brought to the comfort of your home.
MassageCatalog.intro: Every session is delivered to your villa or apartment in the Algarve — choose the focus that suits your day.
MassageCatalog.durationHint: Choose your length in the booking form — same transparent rates as always.

relaxing.title: Relaxing Massage
relaxing.short: A quiet full-body reset in the comfort of your own villa or apartment.
relaxing.description: A calm, unhurried session delivered where you live — no travel, no waiting room. Soft pacing and a private atmosphere so you can settle into rest at home in the Algarve.
relaxing.imageAlt: In-home relaxing massage in a bright residential interior

back-neck.title: Back & Neck Massage
back-neck.short: Focused back and neck care without leaving your living space.
back-neck.description: Shoulders, neck and back — treated at home after desk work, driving or a long day. You stay in your own space; we bring the session to you.
back-neck.imageAlt: Back massage prepared in a warm home setting

face-head.title: Face & Head Massage
face-head.short: Gentle face and scalp work in the quiet of your own rooms.
face-head.description: Light touch for the face, temples, jaw and scalp — in a familiar, private space. Ideal when you want mental quiet without stepping into a salon.
face-head.imageAlt: Gentle face and head massage in a home wellness setting

legs-feet.title: Legs & Feet Massage
legs-feet.short: Legs and feet cared for at home after walks, travel or a warm day.
legs-feet.description: From calves to soles — delivered in your villa or apartment so tired legs can recover where you already are. Steady rhythm, grounded comfort, no clinic feel.
legs-feet.imageAlt: Legs and feet massage on a soft towel at home
